aboutTitle: What does the Meta Tag Generator create?
about: Prepare HTML metadata using your page title, description and optional social sharing information. Review the generated tags before adding them to your website.
example: For a page about a vegetable garden, enter a title such as "Vegetable Garden Planning Guide" and a description that summarizes the advice on that page. Copy the generated tags into the page head.

faqs.question: Where do I put the generated tags?
faqs.answer: Add the tags inside the HTML head of the relevant page. If your website uses a CMS or framework, use its metadata settings or metadata API.

faqs.question: Should every page have the same description?
faqs.answer: Write a description that accurately summarizes each individual page. Review existing metadata before adding generated tags to avoid duplicates.
